text:
anika: Quick catch from customer onboarding: the cost-guidelines page links to /optimize/batching but that anchor 404s, and the example env var still shows BATCH_POLICY=v1 which is deprecated.

ryan: can you paste the exact path? i can run a site crawl if there are multiple occurrences.

anika: path is /handbook/optimize/cost-guidelines.md near the "batching" header. snippet currently:```bash
export BATCH_POLICY=v1
# recommended: BATCH_POLICY=auto_v2
```
This caused confusion in the demo and the customer tried the old flag.

tara: thanks for flagging. i'm swamped but can take ownership if it's small. @docs-owners any objections to assigning?

docs-owners: @platform-team volunteer: tara.

ryan: if tara takes it i can do a quick site grep and add a redirect for the anchor plus a note in the changelog. also suggest we add a micro-eval to the onboarding suite that checks examples match runtime behavior.

anika: micropatch sounds good. also please update the example to mention the new default behavior (auto_v2 will pick quantized profiles). tiny code block suggestion:```bash
# prefer auto_v2 for cost-sensitive workloads
export BATCH_POLICY=auto_v2
```

tara: plan: 1) update env var in doc, 2) fix anchor slug to batching-recommendations, 3) add 301 redirect for old anchor in rewrite map, 4) add a single pytest in docs-evals that validates the sample output and anchor resolution. i'll open PR and run staging smoke tests.

infra-bot: Created ticket INFRA-482 for redirect mapping (owner: ryan).

ryan: LGTM on the redirect plan. i'll scope the nginx rewrite and add test coverage in infra/playbooks.

docs-owners: please add a frontmatter owner (tara) in the doc PR so followups are easier.

tara: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1199 "optimize: update batching example, anchor, redirects, add eval". added changelog note and a one-liner pytest that curls the generated FAQ and checks for the anchor and the expected codeblock.

anika: thanks! can you also add a short line under "migration notes" for customers who might still be using BATCH_POLICY=v1? they hit this during onboarding.

tara: added migration note and a small snippet showing fallback mapping. CI queued.

infra-bot: CI docs build queued at 2024-10-10T08:31:00Z \u2014 build #2301

infra-bot: CI docs build passed at 2024-10-10T08:33:05Z \u2014 smokecheck OK (anchor resolved, example matches runtime)

ryan: will apply the nginx redirect after lunch and then merge the PR once infra mapping is live.

anika: verified in staging: anchor jumps properly and example reflects auto_v2 behavior. thanks all :tada:

ryan: merging after infra deploy. small follow-up: let's add a lint rule to warn on deprecated env var names in docs to avoid this in the future. open to suggestions on where to implement (doc-linter or CI).

tara: good call. i'll open a follow-up issue to add the linter check.

anika: appreciate the quick turnaround. saves the next onboarding call :)
